notes: Transcribed from BMRCL official Revised Fare Chart PDF titled 'BMRCL Fares - 14.02.2025'.
Metric on the chart: 'No. of Stations travelled excluding originating station'.
Feb 2026 annual automatic fare revision was put on hold by BMRCL; these amounts remain the applicable token face fares unless superseded.

BMRCL FFC media brief (08.02.2025) also publishes identical rupee amounts as distance (km) zones. This artifact uses the station-count website chart because authoritative OD network distances are not present in the published topology snapshot; unofficial haversine must not drive fares.
Smart-card / NCMC peak and off-peak discounts are documented on the chart but are not applied here; Decision Engine cost uses token face fares.
